subject: Exclusive Deal Inside: Save on Your Next Purchase!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to offer you an exclusive deal on your next purchase. Simply use the code SAVE20 at checkout to enjoy 20% off your order. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer to save on our latest collection of products. Shop now and treat yourself to something special. We appreciate your continued support and look forward to serving you again soon. Happy shopping! Best regards, The Sales Team
